title: 第21章 分配战利品第22章 离别与惊喜
content_zh:
第21章分配战利品
姜胜犹豫了一下，目光落在林浩和吴峰身上，道：“两位师弟可有其他意见？”
“姜师兄，你来分吧！”
林浩，吴峰两人对视一眼，摇了摇头道。
“承蒙你们看得起，那便我来分。”
姜胜想了想，道：“袁师弟在杀妖兽中出力最大，那头狼王分给袁师弟后，剩下的狼妖由我们三人平分，你们看如何？”
“这可使不得，对付狼王你们也出了不少力。”
袁昌摆了摆手道：“期间若不是你们帮忙出手缓冲，我恐怕在这畜生的攻击下，会受很重的伤。”
“要不这样，我只要狼王的妖丹，狼王肉身给你们分。”
他向三人借了灵石，觉得自己欠了三人大人情，所以抱着让利的心态。
“如果袁师弟只要狼王妖丹，恐怕就吃亏了。”
姜胜忍不住道。
“不吃亏，不吃亏。”
袁昌连忙摇头道：“没有你们，我也没法成外门弟子，狼王肉身就当我感谢你们。”
“既然如此，那我们就不客气了。”
见他坚持，姜胜笑了笑道。
一颗炼气二重的妖丹，大概值四颗下品灵石的样子。
可以用来炼丹，也可直接服用。
但是妖丹能量比较狂暴，服用之后需要花不少的功夫来慢慢消化。
而妖兽的血肉，却可以直接吃，用来炼体。

这头炼气二重的狼王血肉，若是拿去卖，很受低级体修的欢迎，差不多能卖五颗下品灵石的样子。
袁昌主动把狼王血肉让出来，觉得偿还了一些人情，他反而轻松了许多，笑道：“三位师兄弟，都是自己人，不用跟我客气。”
“一头炼气一重的狼妖，血肉加上妖丹，大概值两枚下品灵石。”
姜胜沉吟片刻继续道：“五头狼妖一共加起来值十颗灵石，林师弟和吴师弟这五头炼气一重的狼，你们两人平分如何。”
“我最近炼体只差一点就可突破，那炼气二重的狼妖血肉能卖五颗灵石左右，我比较想要。”
他继续道。
“就按照姜师兄说的分。”
林浩来到玄岳宗一年多，虽只是个杂役弟子，但耳濡目染下，对低级的妖兽价值还是清楚的。
姜胜这样分，确实比较公平，谁也不吃亏。
“我觉得行。”
吴峰点了点头。
商量好战利品分配后，四人开始运功疗伤，待伤口在灵力的滋润下，好了许多后，他们才用剑处理起妖兽尸体。
忙碌了两刻多钟的时间，六颗泛着微光，如珍珠一般半透明的妖丹，全部被取了出来。
至于地上六头妖狼尸体，林浩他们就有些头疼了。
这些妖兽尸体太多，不好带回去，否则容易引起别人的眼红，只能留在外面。
“这里有狼妖的气息，其他野兽不敢来。”
吴峰开口道：“妖兽肉不好带走，咱们就把妖兽肉留在山洞中吧！
现在天气寒冷，也不怕坏掉，可以慢慢吃。”
“嗯，确实只能这样。”
content_en:
Chapter 21 Distributing the spoils
Jiang Sheng hesitated for a moment, his eyes fell on Lin Hao and Wu Feng, and said, "Do you two junior brothers have any other opinions?"
"Senior Brother Jiang, come and share it!"
Lin Hao and Wu Feng looked at each other, shook their heads and said.
"Thank you for your respect, then I will share it."
Jiang Sheng thought for a while and said: "Junior brother Yuan has contributed the most to killing monsters. After the wolf king is given to junior brother Yuan, the remaining wolf monsters will be divided equally among the three of us. What do you think?"
"This is impossible. You have also done a lot to deal with the Wolf King."
Yuan Chang waved his hand and said, "If you hadn't helped buffer me during this period, I'm afraid I would have been seriously injured by this beast's attack."
"Otherwise, I only want the Wolf King's demon elixir, and the Wolf King's body will be shared with you."
He borrowed the spirit stones from the three of them and felt that he owed them a favor, so he had the mentality of giving in to them.
"If Junior Brother Yuan only wants the Wolf King Demon Pill, I'm afraid he will suffer a loss."
Jiang Sheng couldn't help but said.
"Don't suffer, don't suffer."
Yuan Chang shook his head quickly and said: "Without you, I wouldn't be able to become an outer disciple. The Wolf King's body will be considered as my gratitude to you."
"In that case, we won't be polite."
Seeing his persistence, Jiang Sheng smiled.
A second-level Qi refining demon pill is probably worth four low-grade spiritual stones.
It can be used to make elixirs or taken directly.
However, the energy of the demon pill is relatively violent, and it takes a lot of effort to digest it slowly after taking it.
However, the flesh and blood of monster beasts can be eaten directly and used to refine the body.
If this second-level Qi Refining Wolf King's flesh and blood were sold, it would be very popular among low-level physical practitioners and could be sold for about five low-grade spiritual stones.
Yuan Chang took the initiative to give up the flesh and blood of the Wolf King. Feeling that he had repaid some favor, he felt much more relaxed and said with a smile: "The three brothers are all my own, so there is no need to be polite to me."
"A wolf demon with the first level of Qi refining, flesh and blood plus demon elixir, is probably worth two low-grade spiritual stones."
Jiang Sheng pondered for a moment and continued: "The five wolf monsters are worth ten spirit stones in total. Junior Brother Lin and Junior Brother Wu, these five wolves with the first level of Qi Refining, how about you two divide it equally?"
"I'm just a little short of a breakthrough in my recent body refining. The wolf demon flesh and blood at the second level of Qi refining can be sold for about five spiritual stones. I want it more."
he continued.
"Just follow what Senior Brother Jiang said."
Lin Hao has been in Xuanyue Sect for more than a year. Although he is just a handyman disciple, he is still aware of the value of low-level monsters due to his exposure to them.
Jiang Sheng's division is indeed fair and no one suffers.
"I think it's okay."
Wu Feng nodded.
After discussing the distribution of the spoils, the four of them began to perform exercises to heal their wounds. After the wounds were much better under the nourishment of spiritual power, they used their swords to dispose of the corpse of the monster.
After more than two and a quarter of hours of busy work, all six demon pills that shimmered and were as translucent as pearls were taken out.
As for the corpses of the six demon wolves on the ground, Lin Hao and the others had a headache.
There are so many corpses of these monster beasts that it is difficult to take them back, otherwise they will easily arouse the jealousy of others, so they can only be left outside.
"There is the aura of the wolf demon here, and other beasts dare not come."
Wu Feng said: "It's hard to take the monster meat away, so let's just leave the monster meat in the cave!
Now that the weather is cold, I am not afraid of spoilage, so I can eat it slowly. "
"Well, that's really the only way."
